name: LOCALREACH CareReport
author: LOCALREACH

sections.description:
LOCALREACH CareReport Free helps you document website maintenance work and turn technical notes into a customer-friendly report.

The Free edition includes manually created CareReports, customer-friendly report text, basic maintenance checks, an HTML preview, and a print-optimized PDF view.

Pro and Agency are separate commercial editions with additional implementations that are not included in this WordPress.org package.

Included features

  • Create and manage any number of manual maintenance reports.
  • Record the customer, website, reporting period, status and website score.
  • Document completed work, findings, risks and recommended next steps.
  • Mark common maintenance checks as completed.
  • Review the customer-facing report before sharing it.
  • Print the report or save it as a PDF using the browser print dialog.
  • Keep public LOCALREACH attribution disabled unless an administrator explicitly enables it.

Privacy

CareReport stores report content inside your WordPress installation. Report data is not sent to LOCALREACH. The plugin does not include tracking or a Freemius SDK.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the CareReport plugin directory to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate LOCALREACH CareReport in WordPress.
  3. Review the plugin settings before creating a report.

CareReport includes a compatible LOCALREACH Plugin Framework fallback. If a compatible standalone framework is already active, CareReport uses that installation instead.
sections.faq:
Is the WordPress.org edition limited to one report?

No. You can create and manage any number of manual CareReports.

Does CareReport send report data to LOCALREACH?

No. Report content remains inside your WordPress installation.

Can I create a PDF?

CareReport provides a print-optimized view. Select “Print / save as PDF” and use the PDF function provided by your browser or operating system.

Does this package contain paid or locked functionality?

No. Every feature included in this WordPress.org package is available without a license key, payment, quota or time limit. Commercial editions are separate plugins distributed outside WordPress.org.

What happens to reports when the plugin is removed?

Reports and settings are not deleted automatically, so maintenance records are not removed unintentionally.
